## Activity

During March 2024, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 450 captures. Activity was completed through the scheduled session lists, which ran as planned apart from routine leave. The reported volume provides the activity measure for the month and supports review of the site’s operational performance. No additional activity figures are reported in this summary.

## Image quality

There were 21 ungradable captures during the reporting period. The ungradable rate was 4.7 per cent. This result should be considered alongside the total capture volume when monitoring image quality and identifying any need for operational follow-up. The figures provide a concise measure of the proportion of images that could not proceed through grading.

## Grading

Grading identified 105 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 3 days. This indicates the typical interval between image capture and completion of grading for the month. Together, the referable result count and median lag provide the main grading measures for Harbour Eye Clinic in March 2024.
